script_text: Aries, this week Mars — your ruling planet — ignites a firestorm in your 10th House of career, and nothing will stay the same. Early week, Mercury in your 3rd House squares Neptune, creating miscommunications at work Monday through Wednesday, so double-check every email and contract before signing. The turning point arrives Thursday when Venus sextiles your natal Mars, flooding your 5th House of romance with magnetic energy — a surprise connection or rekindled spark is written in the stars. By Friday through Sunday, Jupiter trines your 1st House, amplifying your confidence and drawing opportunities toward you effortlessly. Your best day is Thursday because Venus sextile Mars electrifies love and creativity simultaneously. Your worst day is Tuesday due to the Mercury-Neptune square clouding your judgment. This week, Aries the fire sign, lead with bold action but verify every detail before committing. Follow for daily updates.
